import java.io.BufferedReader
import java.io.InputStreamReader
import java.util.StringTokenizer
import kotlin.math.max
import kotlin.math.min

fun main() {
    val br = BufferedReader(InputStreamReader(System.`in`))
    val st = StringTokenizer(br.readLine())
    val a = st.nextToken().toLong()
    val b = st.nextToken().toLong()
    val c = st.nextToken().toLong()
    val l = st.nextToken().toLong()

    val base = a + b + c
    val total = (l + 3) * (l + 2) * (l + 1) / 6

    fun countInvalid(x: Long, y: Long, z: Long): Long {
        var res = 0L
        var t = 0L
        while (t <= l) {
            val s = l - t
            val minU = max(0L, x + y + t - z + 1)
            val maxU = s
            if (minU <= maxU) {
                val n = maxU - minU + 1
                res += n * (n + 1) / 2

            t++
        }

    val ans = total - invalid
    println(ans)

import java.io.BufferedReader
import java.io.InputStreamReader
import java.util.StringTokenizer
import kotlin.math.max
import kotlin.math.min

fun main() {
    val br = BufferedReader(InputStreamReader(System.`in`))
    val st = StringTokenizer(br.readLine())
    val a = st.nextToken().toLong()
    val b = st.nextToken().toLong()
    val c = st.nextToken().toLong()
    val l = st.nextToken().toLong()

    val base = longArrayOf(a, b, c)
    var ans = 0L

    // total number of non-negative integer solutions x,y,z with x+y+z<=l
    fun totalWays(l: Long): Long {
        val n = l + 3
        return n * (n - 1) * (n - 2) / 6
    }

    // count invalid (degenerate or impossible) for given ordering (a,b,c)
    fun countInvalid(a: Long, b: Long, c: Long, l: Long): Long {
        var res = 0L
        val maxX = l
        var x = 0L
        while (x <= maxX) {
            val s = l - x
            val minY = max(0L, c - b - x)
            val maxY = s
            if (minY > maxY) {
                x++
                continue
            }
            val minZ = max(0L, c - a - x)
            val maxZ = s - minY
            if (minZ > maxZ) {
                x++
                continue
            }
            val totalPairs = (s + 2) * (s + 1) / 2
            val lessThanMinY = if (minY > 0) minY * (minY + 1) / 2 else 0
            val lessThanMinZ = if (minZ > 0) minZ * (minZ + 1) / 2 else 0
            val overlap = if (minY + minZ <= s) {
                val t = s - (minY + minZ)
                (t + 2) * (t + 1) / 2
            } else 0
            val validPairs = totalPairs - lessThanMinY - lessThanMinZ + overlap
            res += validPairs
            x++
        }
        return res
    }

    val total = totalWays(l)
    var invalid = 0L
    invalid += countInvalid(base[0], base[1], base[2], l)
    invalid += countInvalid(base[1], base[2], base[0], l)
    invalid += countInvalid(base[2], base[0], base[1], l)

    ans = total - invalid
    println(ans)
}

import java.io.BufferedReader
import java.io.InputStreamReader
import java.util.StringTokenizer
import kotlin.math.max
import kotlin.math.min

fun main() {
    val br = BufferedReader(InputStreamReader(System.`in`))
    val st = StringTokenizer(br.readLine())
    val a = st.nextToken().toLong()
    val b = st.nextToken().toLong()
    val c = st.nextToken().toLong()
    val l = st.nextToken().toLong()

    val sides = longArrayOf(a, b, c)
    sides.sort()
    val x = sides[0]
    val y = sides[1]
    val z = sides[2]

    var ans = 0L

    fun countNonNegativeSolutions(sum: Long): Long {
        return if (sum < 0) 0L else (sum + 2) * (sum + 1) / 2
    }

    fun countInvalidForLargest(baseX: Long, baseY: Long, baseZ: Long): Long {
        var res = 0L
        val maxD = l
        var d = 0L
        while (d <= maxD) {
            val maxInc = l - d
            val maxSum = maxInc

            val minSum = max(0L, baseZ + d - baseX - baseY + 1)

            if (minSum <= maxSum) {
                val total = countNonNegativeSolutions(maxSum)
                val subtract = countNonNegativeSolutions(minSum - 1)
                res += total - subtract
            }
            d++
        }
        return res
    }

    val totalWays = countNonNegativeSolutions(l)

    val invalidZ = countInvalidForLargest(x, y, z)
    val invalidY = countInvalidForLargest(x, z, y)
    val invalidX = countInvalidForLargest(y, z, x)

    ans = totalWays - (invalidX + invalidY + invalidZ)

    println(ans)
}

import java.io.BufferedReader
import java.io.InputStreamReader
import java.util.StringTokenizer
import kotlin.math.max
import kotlin.math.min

fun main() {
    val br = BufferedReader(InputStreamReader(System.`in`))
    val st = StringTokenizer(br.readLine())
    val a = st.nextToken().toLong()
    val b = st.nextToken().toLong()
    val c = st.nextToken().toLong()
    val l = st.nextToken().toLong()

    val base = longArrayOf(a, b, c)
    var ans = 0L

    fun countNonTriangles(x: Long, y: Long, z: Long): Long {
        var res = 0L
        val maxAdd = l
        var t = 0L
        while (t <= maxAdd) {
            val s = x + y + t - z
            if (s <= 0) {
                t++
                continue
            }
            val maxInc = maxAdd - t
            val maxX = min(s - 1, maxInc)
            if (maxX >= 0) {
                res += maxX + 1
            }
            t++
        }
        return res
    }

    val totalWays = (l + 3) * (l + 2) * (l + 1) / 6

    ans = totalWays
    ans -= countNonTriangles(a, b, c)
    ans -= countNonTriangles(b, c, a)
    ans -= countNonTriangles(c, a, b)

    println(ans)
}

fun main() {
    val br = BufferedReader(InputStreamReader(System.`in`))
    val st = StringTokenizer(br.readLine())
    val a = st.nextToken().toLong()
    val b = st.nextToken().toLong()
    val c = st.nextToken().toLong()
    val l = st.nextToken().toLong()

    val arr = longArrayOf(a, b, c)
    arr.sort()
    val x = arr[0]
    val y = arr[1]
    val z = arr[2]

    var ans = 0L
    // total nonnegative solutions to da+db+dc <= l
    ans = (l + 3) * (l + 2) * (l + 1) / 6

    fun countInvalidForLargest(base1: Long, base2: Long, largest: Long): Long {
        var res = 0L
        val maxD = l
        var dLargest = 0L
        while (dLargest <= maxD) {
            val L = largest + dLargest - (base1 + base2)
            if (L <= 0) {
                dLargest++
                continue
            }
            val rem = maxD - dLargest
            val totalPairs = (rem + 2) * (rem + 1) / 2
            val maxSum = rem
            val minSum = L + 1
            if (minSum > maxSum) {
                dLargest++
                continue
            }
            val s = maxSum - minSum + 1
            val sumMin = minSum
            val invalidPairs = s * (2 * rem - s + 1) / 2 - s * (sumMin - 1)
            res += invalidPairs
            dLargest++
        }
        return res
    }

    ans -= countInvalidForLargest(x, y, z)
    ans -= countInvalidForLargest(x, z, y)
    ans -= countInvalidForLargest(y, z, x)

    println(ans)
}
